# Municipal Ordinance No. KauBayanSaLaangGggulinBlg04S19, Series of 1992

**Kau. Bayan Sa Laang Gggulin Blg. 04**

## Summary

Supplemental Budget Ordinance (Kautusang Bayan sa Laang-Gugulin) No. 04, Series of [[1992]], enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Municipality of Pitogo|Pitogo]], Quezon on November 23, 1992. This ordinance enacts Supplemental Budget No. 2 for the municipal government, appropriating funds from the balance of Supplemental Budget No. 1 and interest/deposit earnings for additional government expenditures.

## Key Provisions

- **Resolution (Kapasiyahan Blg. 67):** The [[Sangguniang Bayan]] resolves to enact Supplemental Budget No. 2 to address the shortfall in the existing budget.
- **Title:** Kautusang Bayan sa Laang-Gugulin Blg. 04, Series of 1992 — an ordinance appropriating One Hundred Forty-Nine Thousand, Five Hundred Four Pesos and Thirteen Centavos (P149,504.13) for municipal government expenditures.
- **Section 1.** From the balance of the Supplemental Budget No. 1 and interest/deposits, totaling One Hundred Forty-Nine Thousand Five Hundred Four Pesos and Thirteen Centavos (P149,504.13), the funds are appropriated for the Infrastructure Fund of the municipal government of Pitogo, Quezon.
- **Section 2.** The Supplemental Budget No. 2 for allocation of the Infrastructure Fund shall be in accordance with the attached schedule marked as Annex "A."
- **Section 3.** This ordinance shall take effect immediately upon approval.

**Total Appropriation:** P149,504.13
**Fund Source:** Balance of Supplemental Budget No. 1 plus interest/deposits

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]] — enacted the ordinance
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]] — local government unit
- [[Domingo L. Tan]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer (Pangandalawang Punong Bayan)
- [[Rafael C. Glinoga]] — Municipal Mayor (approved)
- [[Herminia G. Jatico]] — Temporary Secretary to the Sangguniang Bayan
